alt: All four cutaneous tactile mechanoreceptors at a glance (Blausen). Meissner (light touch, dermal papillae), Pacinian (vibration + deep pressure, deep dermis), Merkel (sustained touch + texture, epidermis), Ruffini (skin stretch, dermis). (Blausen Medical CC BY 3.0)
